Leaving <void/>Void Invisibility while within 15 meters of an enemy releases a cloud of smoke that lasts 7 seconds and <void/>Weakens enemies. 5 second cooldown between uses.

While in <void/>Spectral Blades:
Refunds Super Energy on Heavy Attack based on the number of <void/>Spectral Blade Hits and Kills scored before doing so.
